title: Tutor Kai programming tasks with lecture-grounded GPT-4 feedback
summary: Students complete familiar and new programming tasks in a voluntary exam-preparation workshop. For each code submission, they can request fast GPT-4 feedback or slower RAG feedback linked to relevant timestamps in lecture videos.

sources.title: Leveraging Lecture Content for Improved Feedback: Explorations with GPT-4 and Retrieval Augmented Generation
sources.evidence_quote: As part of a voluntary exam preparation workshop, 15 students participated and used Tutor Kai for two to four hours in person and more online over the following three weeks.

context.learner_level: students preparing for a programming exam

assessment.summary: Solve programming tasks and revise code using generated feedback that may link to supporting lecture-video segments.
student_actions: Write and submit code for familiar and ten new programming tasks.
Choose feedback with or without retrieved lecture information.
Revise solutions without receiving code or the complete answer.

student_role.description: Students choose between direct GPT-4 feedback and RAG-enhanced GPT-4 feedback linked to lecture recordings.

allowed_purposes: Receive concise feedback and links to relevant lecture content
prohibited_actions: Receive code or the assessment solution

assessment_system_role: Diagnose missing concepts from code, tests, and compiler output
Generate feedback with timestamped lecture links

provenance.extraction_method: Full PDF read from pdftotext output.

evidence_excerpts.quote: As part of a voluntary exam preparation workshop, 15 students participated and used Tutor Kai for two to four hours in person and more online over the following three weeks.
